svg.title: Prim's minimum spanning tree algorithm trace
svg.desc: Weighted undirected graph showing Prim's MST construction step by step from vertex A
svg.text: Prim's: grow one tree from a source vertex.
Pick cheapest edge connecting MST to a new vertex.
Kruskal's: sort ALL edges by weight, add edge if it
doesn't form a cycle (union-find). Builds forest.
Both give same MST total weight!
Prim's: O(V²) or O(E log V) with heap
Kruskal's: O(E log E) — better for sparse graphs
